root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: (size_t) ((char *) encap - (char *) out->base) == saved encap slot offset
root_cause_criterion.criterion: After `decode_ed_prop(&ofp_prop, out, &props_len)` may grow `out`, `decode_NXAST_RAW_ENCAP()` must refresh `encap` before `encap->n_props = n_props` so the current `encap` offset inside `out` still equals the slot offset saved before `ofpact_put_ENCAP(out)` appended the action.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original reaches the protected `encap->n_props` write with `encap_offset_now` no longer equal to the saved slot offset after property decoding has moved `out->base`; the fixed original restores `encap` from `ofpbuf_at_assert(out, encap_ofs, sizeof *encap)` before the same write.

nodes.state: The source-level sink writes `n_props` through the same local `encap` pointer captured at the post-decode guard event.
Across the relevant `decode_ed_prop()` call, `out->base` changes to a different heap address, ending the lifetime of the old `ofpacts` buffer that `encap` still names.

edges.relation: The same local `encap` pointer observed immediately after property decoding is passed unchanged into the later `encap->n_props = n_props` write.
